title: Patients With Congenital Myasthenic Syndrome Will be Treated With Umbilical or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cell Exosome Solution
official: Mesenchymal Stem Cell Exosome Treatment of Congenital Myasthenic Syndrome
summary: Patients with Congenital Myasthenic Syndrome will be treated with Umbilical or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cell Exosome solution.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients will need a diagnosis of Congenital Myasthenic Syndrome by a licensed physician.
* Patients must be able to provide informed consent, or have a guardian who does.
* Patient must be able to travel to the site of treatment.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients will be excluded from the trial if they are pregnant or have active cancer (malignancy) at the screening consultation.
sponsor: The Foundation for Orthopaedics and Regenerative Medicine
